Willie Mullins fined, horse disqualified after failed drug test

Trainer Willie Mullins has been fined and his horse disqualified after a runner-up at the Cheltenham Festival failed a drug test for mepivacaine. Mullins was reportedly "visibly shocked" by the development. The horse was disqualified for failing to declare the use of the substance.
